<style>
  @page { size: Letter; margin: 18mm; }
  body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; color: #222; }
  .statement-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 2px solid #222; padding-bottom: 10px; }
  .church-name { font-size: 15pt; font-weight: bold; }
  .church-address, .church-tax { color: #666; font-size: 9pt; white-space: pre-line; }
  .statement-label { text-align: right; }
  .doc-title { font-size: 12pt; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
  .period { color: #666; font-size: 9pt; }
  .addressed-to { margin: 18px 0; }
  .donor { font-size: 12pt; font-weight: bold; }
  .muted { color: #888; font-size: 9pt; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
  table.lines { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; }
  table.lines th { text-align: left; font-size: 8.5pt; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #666; border-bottom: 1px solid #bbb; padding: 6px 4px; }
  table.lines td { padding: 5px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; }
  table.lines .num { text-align: right; }
  table.lines tfoot td { border-top: 2px solid #222; border-bottom: none; font-weight: bold; padding-top: 8px; }
  .total { font-size: 12pt; }
  .acknowledgment { margin-top: 22px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid #ddd; font-size: 9pt; color: #444; }
</style>

{% include "churchit/templates/includes/giving_statement_body.html" %}
